title: The steps
goals: Reach the spot before the gate.
starting_code:
# The program gets there but bumps. Make it better!
wizard.move_right(7)
wizard.move_up(5)
hints: Count the exact number of steps you need to take right and up.
The numbers in the brackets are a little too big.
Change the arguments so your wizard takes exactly five steps right and four steps up.
intro: My program walks back to the gate, but the numbers are too big and it bumps into a tree and the wall! Can you make the code better so we arrive safely?
outro: That was perfect! Your code is getting very precise. Now we are back at the gate.
learned: Now you know that a working program can still be made better, like giving each move the exact argument it needs.
